subject: Whistic inventory hand‑off & evidence ownership (next steps)
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmeco.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmeco.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic inventory sync and evidence ownership for renewal

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We pulled your Whistic profile and noticed a few gaps in the SIG mapping vs. our CAIQ template. Before we start the formal intake for renewal, can we lock down who will own each proof item (e.g., SOC2 sections, KMS rotation logs, ephemeral credential screenshots)?

Action we need from you:
- Confirm primary evidence owner for the SOC2 artifact list (or mark items for us to chase).
- Share any current presigned S3 buckets or a Drive link for artifacts.
- Tell us whether Redwood will accept matrix-level assertions for low-risk items or prefer raw artifacts.

I've attached a first-pass mapping (SIG_Mapping_Acme_v1.xlsx) and an index of what we expect for SOC2 (SOC2_Artifacts_Index.pdf).

Can we aim to have owners assigned by EOD Friday so our audit team can start sampling next week?

Best,
Lina Torres
Security Program Manager
Acme Commerce

-- Attachment stubs: SIG_Mapping_Acme_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Artifacts_Index.pdf (pdf)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmeco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic inventory sync and evidence ownership for renewal

Lina — thanks for the packet and for flagging the mapping. Copying Marissa (who runs portal uploads) and Jonas (security lead) to confirm owners.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide raw artifacts for SOC2 core sections (logs, policy PDFs, attestation letter). For low-risk config questions we prefer matrix assertions to avoid oversharing.
- We currently store signed artifacts in a locked GDrive folder; Marissa will create a presigned S3 bucket for temporary transfer if that speeds sampling.
- I'll volunteer Redwood as primary owner for items under our infra & KMS scope; Marissa will list the specific files and owners by Friday.

Open questions for Acme:
1) Do you need notarized timestamps for KMS rotations, or is signed audit log export enough?
2) For ephemeral credential proof, will a short video walkthrough of creating a temp token suffice, or do you require a signed-presence artifact?

Jonas/Marissa — can you take the attachment and map owners? Lina — we'll populate your SIG mapping and push back a cleaned XLS by Thursday.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Compliance (Redwood Inference)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmeco.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2027 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic inventory sync and evidence ownership for renewal

On Wed, Oct 21, 2027 at 10:08 AM kimberly.park@redwood.ai wrote:
> Lina — thanks for the packet and for flagging the mapping. Copying Marissa (who runs portal uploads) and Jonas (security lead) to confirm owners.

Hi Lina / Kim — taking point on the uploads. I've started a checklist and a short sprint for this:
- Wednesday: review SIG_Mapping_Acme_v1.xlsx and mark which items we already have in Drive.
- Thursday: export evidence index and generate presigned S3 buckets for bulk transfer (48hr TTL).
- Friday: deliver a cleaned SIG mapping with column Owner (internal), Evidence path, and Transfer method.

Notes / clarifications:
- For KMS rotation we'd prefer an exported audit log (timestamped events) plus the CAIQ mapping. Notarized timestamps are overkill for our environment unless Acme's audit requires it.
- For ephemeral credential proof: we can provide a short screencast + a signed manifest (hash) showing session creation if that meets sampling requirements.

I've attached the checklist stub and will populate the Drive at the link below. Please confirm if presigned S3 with 48hr TTL is acceptable.

Marissa Cole
Inventory & Portal Operations (Redwood Inference)
-- Attachment stubs: evidence-upload-checklist.md (text)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeEvidence
Presigned transfer ETA: Thu 22 Oct, 15:00 PDT (48hr TTL)

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acmeco.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic inventory sync and evidence ownership for renewal

Kimberly / Marissa — this is perfect, thanks. 48hr presigned S3 windows work for our audit team; the exported KMS logs + screencast/hash manifest will be fine (no notarization required).

Two quick asks before you upload:
- Please include a short CSV mapping with three columns: item_id, owner_email, and sample_window_preference (e.g., immediate, next-week). It helps us schedule samplings.
- If any items are not shareable (vendor agreements, PII redaction), mark them in the Owner column and add a brief rationale.

We'll queue sampling requests as soon as the S3 manifest is live. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lina
Security Program Manager
Acme Commerce
